text_outline.condition: Text operands in boolean operations; authorized readable fonts also required

edge_tts.condition: Explicitly authorized network narration request to selected provider

video_subtitles.condition: Explicitly provisioned model/runtime; never auto-download at skill invocation

powerpoint_video.condition: Native PowerPoint video export; not available merely because PPTX generation works

svg_preview.condition: Optional preview only, never substitutes for native editable objects

pdf_input.license: AGPL-3.0 or commercial license, independent of ppt-master MIT
pdf_input.condition: PDF-source input adapter only; deployment must resolve applicable license before installation/use

missing_behavior: Fail only the selected operation with a concrete missing dependency; never auto-install, silently drop a capability, choose a paid provider or substitute raster output.
